query: What is the punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder?

phase8.query: What is the punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder?

variants.name: original
variants.query: What is the punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder?

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than five years but which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine, if the act by which the death is caused is done with the intention of causing death, or of causing such bodily injury as is likely to cause death; or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years and with fine, if the act is done with the knowledge that it is likely to cause death, but without any intention to cause death, or to cause such bodily injury as is likely to cause death. Causing death by negligence.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
Section 105: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than five years but which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine, if the act by which the death is caused is done with the intention of causing death, or of causing such bodily injury as is likely to cause death; or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years and with fine, if the act is done with the knowledge that it is likely to cause death, but without any intention to cause death, or to cause such bodily injury as is likely to cause death. Causing death by negligence.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text: Whoever, being under sentence of imprisonment for life, commits murder, shall be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, which shall mean the remainder of that person’s natural life. Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
Section 104: Punishment for murder by life-convict.
Whoever, being under sentence of imprisonment for life, commits murder, shall be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, which shall mean the remainder of that person’s natural life. Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

original.text: A attacks Z under such circumstances of grave provocation that his killing of Z would be only culpable homicide not amounting to murder. B, having ill-will towards Z and intending to kill him, and not having been subject to the provocation, assists A in killing Z. Here, though A and B are both engaged in causing Z’s death, B is guilty of murder, and A is guilty only of culpable homicide. OF PUNISHMENTS Punishments.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 1: PRELIMINARY
Section 3: General explanations.
Where several persons are engaged or concerned in the commission of a criminal act, they may be guilty of different offences by means of that act.
A attacks Z under such circumstances of grave provocation that his killing of Z would be only culpable homicide not amounting to murder. B, having ill-will towards Z and intending to kill him, and not having been subject to the provocation, assists A in killing Z. Here, though A and B are both engaged in causing Z’s death, B is guilty of murder, and A is guilty only of culpable homicide. OF PUNISHMENTS Punishments.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both; and, if hurt is caused to any person by such act, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
Section 110: Attempt to commit culpable homicide.
Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both; and, if hurt is caused to any person by such act, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text:
Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and
under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be
guilty of culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished
with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to
three years, or with fine, or with both; and, if hurt is caused to any person
by such act, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for
a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
Illustration.
A, on grave and sudden provocation, fires a pistol at Z, under such
circumstances that if he thereby caused death, he would be guilty of
culpable homicide not amounting to murder. A has committed the offence
defined in this section.
Organised crime.
legal_concepts: culpable homicide not amounting to murder

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text: Whoever causes death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine; and if such act is done by a registered medical practitioner while performing medical procedure, he shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, and shall also be liable to fine.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
Section 106: Causing death by negligence.
Whoever causes death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine; and if such act is done by a registered medical practitioner while performing medical procedure, he shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, and shall also be liable to fine.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
original.text: For the purposes of this sub-section, “registered medical practitioner” means a medical practitioner who possesses any medical qualification recognised under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019 and whose name has been entered in the National Medical Register or a State Medical Register under that Act.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY
Section 106: Causing death by negligence.
Whoever causes death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine; and if such act is done by a registered medical practitioner while performing medical procedure, he shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, and shall also be liable to fine.
For the purposes of this sub-section, “registered medical practitioner” means a medical practitioner who possesses any medical qualification recognised under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019 and whose name has been entered in the National Medical Register or a State Medical Register under that Act.

phase11.final_answer: The punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder is imprisonment for life or a term of 5 to 10 years, and may include a fine, depending on the circumstances of the act.
phase11.summary_answer: The punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder includes imprisonment for life or a term of 5 to 10 years, along with a fine, depending on the intention or knowledge of the act.
phase11.detailed_answer: According to Section 105 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term not less than five years but which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine if the act is done with the intention of causing death or causing bodily injury likely to cause death. If the act is done with knowledge that it is likely to cause death but without intention, the punishment is imprisonment for a term that may extend to ten years and a fine. Additionally, Section 110 outlines that if an act is done with intention or knowledge that could lead to culpable homicide not amounting to murder, the punishment can be imprisonment for up to three years or a fine, or both, and if hurt is caused, the punishment can extend to seven years.
